notes.title: v2 Update: Pedestrian System, Optimized Graphics & Camera Fixes
notes.notes:
With the Cargo Truck Simulator 2023 v2 update, you're one step closer to a true transportation experience. This major update makes the city more vibrant, driving more realistic, and the user experience smoother. Discover the innovations shaped by player feedback!

v2 Update Notes
[list]
[*] Pedestrian NPC System added: Now there are people in the city! This new system increases realism with pedestrian traffic, which you should be aware of while transporting.
[*] Graphics quality improved and optimizations achieved: The game has been visually upgraded with clearer textures, improved environmental details, and improved lighting. It also offers better performance on low-end hardware.
[*] Camera bugs fixed, system improvements improved: Issues with interior and exterior camera transitions have been addressed. A more stable and fluid viewing angle is now offered.
[*] General bug fixes: Numerous bugs have been fixed in areas such as mission triggers, sounds, and traffic behavior. Overall stability has been improved.
[*] UI adjustments made: Mission screens, button locations, and information panels have been made more user-friendly. Navigation and interaction have been made easier.
[/list]
